summary: Kennametal Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a cash tender offer to purchase any and all of its 4.625% Senior Notes due 2028 (CUSIP 489170AE0, $300M outstanding). Concurrently, the company launched a public offering of new senior notes. The tender is subject to terms in the Offer to Purchase dated May 19, 2026; pricing references the 3.875% U.S. Treasury due March 2028 plus 30 bps spread. The board of directors implicitly authorized the transaction; no advisor is named. The tender is a straight debt buyback with no premium stated. Regulatory clock is immediate. What to watch: pricing of the new notes and the take-up rate; risk-arb angle is minimal as this is a liability management transaction.
